description: Evaluates the critic stage on technical exploit viability, untrusted entrypoint reachability, and framework mitigation barriers.

finding.title: Remote code execution via YAML deserialization in public webhook
finding.description: Publicly accessible unauthenticated POST /webhook calls yaml.unsafe_load on request body.

ground_truth.rationale: Publicly exposed endpoint with zero auth prerequisites and direct arbitrary code execution.

finding.title: Buffer overflow in administrative hardware diagnosis CLI
finding.description: Local memory corruption only accessible when executed by root with explicit --dangerous-hardware-test flag.

ground_truth.rationale: Requires pre-existing root privileges on the local host.

finding.title: Theoretical SSRF in cloud key retrieval client
finding.description: Outbound HTTP request uses urlopen, but target URL is strictly hardcoded constant to internal cloud KMS.

ground_truth.rationale: Target URL is hardcoded with no caller control over host, scheme, or path.

finding.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference in order status modification API
finding.description: Standard authenticated users can update the order status of other users by altering order_id.

ground_truth.rationale: Reachable by any low-privilege authenticated user across tenant boundaries.
